report.title: GET /api/calls/token/:roomName returns 404 — call fails to join
report.symptom: When a user tries to initiate or accept a voice/video call, the client fetches the LiveKit token from GET /api/calls/token/call-f037bde0-5f4a-42f9-88b8-02873cdc98b5 and receives a 404 response in ~26ms, causing the call to abort with the message 'Failed to join the call'.

observed_behavior.call_result: Call is cancelled immediately for both caller and callee

root_cause_hypotheses.description: Route file is missing or placed at the wrong path. In Next.js App Router, dynamic segments require bracket folders. The correct path is app/api/calls/token/[roomName]/route.ts. Common mistakes include: app/api/calls/token/route.ts (no dynamic segment), app/api/calls/[roomName]/token/route.ts (wrong order), or a plain file named roomName instead of a bracketed folder.
The route file exists but the GET export is missing or incorrectly named. Next.js App Router requires a named export 'export async function GET(...)' — a default export will not work.
The route exists but throws an unhandled exception (e.g. missing env variable, Drizzle query error, livekit-server-sdk import error) and Next.js returns 404/500 before sending a proper response.
The client is calling the wrong URL — e.g. using a hardcoded path or missing the roomName interpolation, resulting in a malformed URL that matches no route.
The call_history row does not exist or has a status other than 'ongoing' when the token is requested, causing a premature 404 from inside the handler logic.

agent_prompt.role: You are a senior full-stack engineer working on TruckConnect, a Next.js 14 App Router application. You have full access to the codebase. Your task is to diagnose and fully fix a critical bug preventing voice and video calls from working.
agent_prompt.objective: Fix the 404 error on GET /api/calls/token/:roomName so that both voice and video calls can successfully connect via LiveKit.

step_1_diagnose.title: Audit the file system first
actions: List the contents of app/api/calls/ recursively to see what route files actually exist
If it does not exist, identify where the file is (wrong location) or confirm it needs to be created
Check if the file exports a named GET function — not a default export

step_2_create_or_fix_route.title: Create or fix app/api/calls/token/[roomName]/route.ts
requirements: Must be a Next.js App Router route file with a named export: export async function GET(request, { params })
Extract roomName from params: const { roomName } = await params (use await for Next.js 14 async params)
Call requireSession() from lib/auth-helpers.ts to get the current user session — return 401 if not authenticated
Query the call_history table using Drizzle ORM: find a row where roomName matches AND (caller_id = userId OR callee_id = userId) AND status = 'ongoing'
If no matching row is found, return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Call not found or already ended' }, { status: 404 })
Generate a LiveKit AccessToken using livekit-server-sdk: import { AccessToken } from 'livekit-server-sdk'
Use env.LIVEKIT_API_KEY and env.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET from lib/env.ts (never process.env directly)
Set token identity to userId (string), TTL to '5m'
Add grant: { roomJoin: true, room: roomName, canPublish: true, canSubscribe: true }
If the call_history row has started_at = null (callee is joining for first time), update started_at = new Date() using Drizzle
Return NextResponse.json({ token: jwt, liveKitUrl: env.LIVEKIT_URL }, { status: 200 })
Wrap the entire handler in try/catch — on error log it and return status 500 with a safe error message

step_3_verify_env.title: Verify environment variables
actions: Open schemas/env.schema.ts and confirm LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET are in the Zod schema with z.string().min(1)
If any are missing from the schema, add them
Confirm all three are present in .env.local with correct values: LIVEKIT_URL must start with wss://, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET must match your LiveKit server config
Confirm lib/env.ts re-exports these three new variables

step_4_verify_db_schema.title: Verify call_history table exists in Drizzle schema
actions: Open db/schema.ts and confirm a callHistory table is defined with columns: id, roomName, callerId, calleeId, callType, status (enum: ongoing|completed|missed|declined), startedAt, endedAt, durationSeconds, createdAt
If the table is missing, create it in db/schema.ts using Drizzle pgTable syntax
Run npm run db:generate and npm run db:migrate to apply the migration
Confirm the callHistory export is available for import in route handlers

step_5_fix_client_join_logic.title: Fix the client-side call join flow
actions: Find the component or hook responsible for joining a call (likely hooks/useCallState.ts, hooks/useLiveKitRoom.ts, or the page at app/(protected)/calls/[roomName]/page.tsx)
Ensure the token fetch happens BEFORE room.connect() is called — never call connect() with an undefined or empty token
The fetch must be: const res = await fetch(`/api/calls/token/${roomName}`)
Check res.ok before proceeding — if false, throw an error to trigger the catch block
Pass the token and liveKitUrl from the response directly to room.connect(liveKitUrl, token)
Wrap the entire join sequence in try/catch
On catch: call DELETE /api/calls/${roomName} to clean up the room, show a toast notification 'Failed to join the call', navigate the user back to /messages

step_6_verify_other_call_routes.title: Verify the other call API routes also exist and are correct

routes_to_check.check: Exists and correctly creates a LiveKit room + inserts call_history row with status='ongoing' + publishes call_incoming Ably event
Exists and deletes the LiveKit room, updates call_history status to completed/declined, publishes call_ended Ably event
Exists and sets call_history status to declined, publishes call_declined Ably event to caller

step_7_test.title: Test the fix
steps: Restart the Next.js dev server: npm run dev
Initiate a voice call from User A to User B
Verify POST /api/calls/initiate returns 200 with { roomName, token }
Verify GET /api/calls/token/{roomName} returns 200 with { token, liveKitUrl } for both users
Verify the LiveKit room connects successfully (no 'Failed to join' toast)
Verify the call_history row is updated with started_at timestamp
End the call and verify call_history status becomes 'completed'

constraints: Do not use process.env directly — always import from lib/env.ts
Do not expose LIVEKIT_API_SECRET or LIVEKIT_API_KEY to the client
Token TTL must not exceed 10 minutes
All DB queries must use Drizzle ORM — no raw SQL
All route handlers must use NextResponse from next/server
Do not remove or modify existing Ably event handling in useSocket.ts
Keep all existing auth patterns — use requireSession() for protected routes
